subject: maths
question:
What is the median of the following distribution?

 
 

 Class
 150-200
 200-250
 250-300
 300-350
 350-400
 
 
 
 

 Frequency
 20
 19
 32
 27
 12
solution:
**Given:**

Class intervals and their corresponding frequencies:

Class: 150-200, 200-250, 250-300, 300-350, 350-400

Frequency: 20, 19, 32, 27, 12

**Formula used:**

Median = L + [(N/2 - CF) / f] × h

Where:

L = lower boundary of the median class

N = total frequency

CF = cumulative frequency before the median class

f = frequency of the median class

h = class width
